build_ViTFeat_model: build a ViTFeat model with pretrained DINO weights to extract key features from images
create_vit_base: create a ViT base vision transformer model with 768 embedding dimensions and 12 layers
create_vit_small: create a ViT small vision transformer model with 384 embedding dimensions and 12 layers
extract_VisionTransformer_selfattention: extract the last self-attention map from a VisionTransformer model given an input image
extract_VisionTransformer_intermediate_l: extract intermediate layer outputs from the last n blocks of a VisionTransformer model
